text:
Luxury 1BR in The Arc – Lease Takeover – May Move-In + Renewal Option
We are offering a lease takeover for our beautiful 1-bedroom apartment at The Arc, available for a May move-in (flexible).

This is a great opportunity to live in one of New Rochelle’s premier luxury buildings, with the added benefit of locking in our current rent and having the option to renew the lease directly with management at the end of the term (Jan 2027)—with potential concessions available at renewal.

Base Rent: 2,950

(About 3,150 after all fees. Some optional, some not) 

Apartment Features:

 • Spacious and modern 1-bedroom layout

 • Large windows with great natural light

 • Updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances

 • In-unit washer/dryer

 • Ample closet space

 • Clean, well-maintained unit

Building Amenities:

 • Luxury lobby and resident lounges

 • Fully equipped fitness center

 • Co-working spaces

 • Outdoor areas / terrace

 • Valet parking available

 • Pet-friendly building

Location:

 • Prime New Rochelle location

 • Walking distance to restaurants, shops, and waterfront

 • Easy access to Metro-North (quick commute to NYC)

Lease Details:

 • Lease takeover through February 2027

 • Option to renew directly with building

 • Applicants will go through standard building approval process

 • Flexible move-in date in May

We have really enjoyed living here and are happy to help make the transition as smooth as possible.

Feel free to reach out with any questions or to schedule a viewing!

text:
2 bed 1 bath in Bushwick $3300
Looking for someone to take over the lease for the entire place, 5/1 -9/30 with the option to re-sign the lease. 

Spacious, sunny, 2 bed 1 bath. Pets allowed. The landlord ALWAYS responded to any requests in a timely manner. For example, they replaced a wonky oven/stove on the actual morning of thanksgiving. The building is incredibly well maintained. There’s a cleaning crew that comes two times per week to take care of trash and washing the floors in the shared spaces. 

There’s a locked mailroom, bike storage, in building washer/dryer, gym with weights and peloton bike. And a huge furnished roof space. Steps from Maria Hernandez Park. Equal distance between the Jefferson L and Myrtle M train (7 min walk each way).

Sublease agreement required along with security deposit. DM if interested.

text:
Looking for a 1B or Studio in manhattan or Brooklyn. 

Location: Ideally downtown Brooklyn, Williamsburg, FiDi, midtown, west village, east village, UES, UWS

Period: Mid April - Aug/Dec. minimum 3 months, can go as long as 6 or 9 months

**Studio in Bedford-Stuyvesant | $3,215/mo | Lease Takeover**

Available May 11 – October 31, 2026 (renewable)

**The Apartment**
* Studio with a layout that lives like a one-bedroom — kitchen is fully separate from the sleeping/living area
* Lofted high ceilings with exceptional natural light
* Modern finishes: solid stone countertops, wide plank flooring, stainless steel appliances
* Generous closet and storage space
* Laundry on the same floor, one room away
* Willing to leave some furniture behind
* Pet friendly

**Amenities**
* Part-time doorman
* Roof terrace with pergolas, sundeck, dog run, and BBQ
* Landscaped courtyard
* Fitness center and pet spa
* Indoor and outdoor resident lounges
* Private party room, business center, and conference room
* Indoor parking, bike storage, and storage rooms

**Transit**
* J/M/Z trains, approx 5 min walk
* G train, approx 15 min walk
* Multiple bus lines within a short walk

DM for details or to schedule a showing

text: Hi, if anyone is looking for an alcove studio in midtown east, send me a DM!

Hi all! My roommate and I are looking to fill the third room (with a dedicated bathroom for your use) in our cute Williamsburg apt starting April 1, 2026!
This will be a sublet until July 31 then potentially lease takeover starting Aug 1, 2026 if we're a good fit (renewal decision is due as early as Jun 1 and both my roommate and I plan to re-sign).

Largest bedroom and private bathroom in a 3 bed 2 bath for $2,300 per month in a modern Williamsburg apartment. This includes gas but excludes electric and wifi which come up to approx $100 depending on the season.

Perks:

- In-unit washer/dryer (!!)

- Dishwasher

- HVAC unit in room (central heat and AC)

- Gym 

- Lounge

- Rooftop with beautiful skyline views

- Virtual doorman

- Package room

- Elevator building

- 3 minute walk from Lorimer St J/M and Broadway G subway stations

- Grocery stores (Food Bazaar & Brooklyn Harvest) and pharmacy (Walgreens) within a 7 mins walk

- Rent stabilized (!!)

The room can come fully furnished or unfurnished.

A little about who we are looking for:

- Is okay only cooking vegetarian food in the house

- Extremely clean/tidy and appreciates a weekly cleaning schedule

- Enjoys a quiet, calm space and is respectful of a 10pm bedtime

- Is comfortable having guests as we love to host friends/family or sublease when we travel (we will always provide notice and double-check though!)

- Values honest communication and isn’t afraid to receive/provide feedback

- Wants to be friends with roommates! (No pressure though!)

- No pets please

A little about us (the roommates):

We're both in our late 20s. My roommate works remotely as a project manager and I am doing my PhD at NYU. We're both pretty friendly, considerate, and respectful and like to keep a calm, relaxing space at home!

text:
EDIT 3/31/26: I found out my work is moving office locations so now looking primarily at Manhattan (East Village, Midtown East/Murray Hill, Greenwich Village, etc.) - reach out if you're also interested in these areas for a 5/1 start with a ~3k budget!

Hi! My name's Angela and I'm looking for a clean roommate to apartment hunt with in a short timeframe. Ideally looking to move in the next week or so, open to a 2B2B lease that starts pretty soon (April 15th-May 1st ish start). 

Budget: up to $3,000, the places I'm looking at are around $5600-6000 so ideally your budget is around the same.

Things I'm looking for:
Private bathroom/shower
In-unit W/D
<30 minute commute to Bowling Green/Broad St
Looking for more of a new build (I want something modern/bright/clean), this isn't a dealbreaker for me though
Personal asks:
Cleanliness is incredibly important to me – I would love for the apartment to be shoes off and for shared areas to be kept tidy, with chores split and no dishes left in the sink
I believe strongly in communication - and would love my roommate to be the same! I'm also very social and would love to be friends with my roommate, but am also happy to give you your personal space as needed
Male/Female roommate okay, LGBTQ-friendly!
Pays rent on time
A little about me: I'm 24 years old, originally from the Bay Area, California, and moving to NYC to start a new job! I will either be 3 days in office or fully in-person. I’m super social/outgoing and very clean, and I love to explore nearby areas, eat, go on hikes, go out, and travel!

Contact: Feel free to text me at (925) 436-6826 or message me on FB if you feel like we would be a good fit/are looking for the same things, or have a lead on a place!

Looking for someone to sublease a fully furnished room in a newly renovated 3-bedroom apartment at 55 Broad St. in the Financial District. The apartment has brand new furniture and a new bed, and we are the first tenants in the unit.

You’ll be sharing the apartment with two roommates (females) in a luxury building with full amenities, including coworking lounges, private WFH work pods, a TechnoGym fitness center, and a yoga studio for all the fitness enthusiasts.

# **Looking for vegetarian/vegan roommate(s) for mid-June move-in**

**Summary:** Looking to meet 1–2 roommates to search for an apartment together.

**Timeline:** Mid-June move-in

**Budget:** ~$1,500–$1,800 (flexible for a good deal)

**Location:** Manhattan, within a 30-min commute to Hell's Kitchen. Open to any neighborhood that fits (Murray Hills, East side, West side, Gramercy, etc).

**About Me:** I'm (23M) a recent grad from McGill university, in Montreal, Canada and relocating to NYC in mid-June for a new role in finance. I don't know many people heading to New York, so I'm looking to meet new people who are also a good fit — not just fill a room.

**Living Situation:** I work long hours on weekdays – I'm rarely home during the day. I keep shared spaces clean and tidy, and I respect everyone's space. A shared meat-free kitchen is important to me, so I'm specifically looking for roommates who are either vegetarian/vegan or will not bring meat in the house.

**Hobbies:** Big sports guy – huge hockey fan (coming from Montreal, Go Habs Go🍁🤙), hit the gym regularly, and likes to play any racquet sport. On weekends I like getting out, exploring the city, recreating the Hangout 2 picture in Bangkok, trying new restaurants, and meeting new people.

**Meeting Up:** Drop a comment or DM me. Happy to hop on a call to see if we're a good fit.

Steps from multiple subway lines, about 10 min to Midtown

Lease runs through August 2027. Standard 40x income requirement applies. All applicants go through the building's official application process.

Hola Buenas Tardes , 

Estoy buscando un cuarto con baño privado y con clóset en Queens. Puedo pagar 1,000 con depósito. Soy una mujer sin niños/mascotas , y nada de vicios , trabajo tiempo completo entonces casi no paso mucho tiempo en la casa. Si alguien sabe de algo porfavor no duden en avisarme , para mudarme el Abril 31 o Mayo 1.

Hey Good Afternoon ,

I am looking a room with a private bathroom and closet in Queens. I am willing to pay 1,000 for rent as well as a deposit. I am a female with no kids/pets and I don’t drink nor smoke, I am a full time worker so I barely be at home. If any one knows of something please let me know , ready to move in April 31 or May 1.

looking for a long term roommate to take over the lease for the second room in my 2 bed/1 bath on the astoria / LIC border for a june 1st move in date!

rent~ 1730 each (rent stabilized, utilities not included)

apt details: 
- washer dryer in unit
- dishwasher
- huge kitchen, lots of counter space
- floor to ceiling windows in bedrooms
- down the block from Q69 / Q100 / B62 buses, 10 min walk to Broadway N/W trains, and 10 min walk from astoria ferry!
- elevator in building
- rooftop with views of manhattan skyline

must be okay with cats (i have 2) and generally be pretty clean, my biggest rule is that shoes come off at the door 🙂

please message me if interested!

text:
🌿 Cozy Clinton Hill-Brooklyn Sublet | March 25– April 25 | $1700

Sublet available:  1 bedroom, 1 bathroom + designated living room space in a charming Clinton Hill apartment (of a 2-bedroom, 2 bathroom and 2 living room bi-level apartment). You’ll share the kitchen and desk nook with one friendly, vegan female roommate—she has her own separate bedroom, bathroom, and living room, so you’ll be able to enjoy some alot of your own designated space.

🛏️ Your Space Includes:

• Private bedroom, bathroom, and living room (living room space has open/studio concept as there is no wall to separate kitchen from living room area - possible room divider ). Bedroom is completely private.

• Shared kitchen and desk area

• Rear unit on the 1st floor with semi-private backyard access

• Laundry in basement

• Bike storage in basement 

📍 Location Highlights:

• Clinton Hill, Brooklyn

• 3–4 minute walk to subway station (2-3 stops to Manhattan)

• Grocery store + coffee/deli just 1 block away

• Surrounded by cafes, restaurants, and quiet tree-lined streets

• 15-minute drive or train ride to Lower Manhattan

• Street parking available 

💰 Rent: $1700

📅 Dates: March 25 – April 25 (can adjust +/- a few days)

Perfect for someone seeking a calm, cozy, and well-connected place to stay. Reach out if you’re interested or have questions!

# **📍Furnished Studio Sublease – Downtown Brooklyn / Prospect Heights | 6 months (April 1 – Sept 30) **

Hey everyone! I’m subleasing my fully furnished studio this spring and summer while I'm away from the city.

**Rent:** $2,895 + Utilities 

**About the space: **
* Private, spacious studio all to yourself
* Fully furnished: comfy full-size bed, desk, dresser, kitchenware, appliances, high-speed WiFi + smart TV
* Secure building with 24/7 doorman, elevators, and laundry on every floor
*  Building amenities: gym, rooftop, co-working lounge, central heat/AC

**Location:**
* 5–10 min walk to 10+ subway lines (B, D, N, Q, R, 2, 3, 4, 5, C, G, LIRR)
* Walking distance from Barclays Center, Atlantic Terminal, Whole Foods, Trader Joe’s, Prospect 
* Nearby tons of great restaurants + bars on Atlantic Ave and 5th
* Family-oriented neighborhood

**Sublease Details:**
* Looking for someone who can move in by early April, unfortunately the date isn’t flexible. 
* **Long-term lease:** min 6 months, shorter stays are not available
* Utilities include Wi-Fi (~$90/mo) and electricity (~$120/mo depending on usage)
* NO pets and NO smoking

**Ideal subletter:**
* Responsible and respectful of the space
* Reliable with communication
* Solo occupant
* Happy to water my 3 very low-maintenance plants 🌿

**If interested:** please send a short intro about yourself, your move-in timeline, and confirm that the April start date + 6-month lease work for you. Serious inquiries only please, I'm looking for someone ready to move forward. Happy to answer any additional questions/do a virtual tour

In my free time I love to read, frolic outside, solidcore, arts and crafts, etc. I recently started my bravo journey (watching rhobh rn). I mostly listen to electronic music so if you don’t enjoy loud beep boop oontz oontz music don’t reach out ❤

Who you are:
- Queer, women, and/or poc preferred
- A clean and organized person (idc about ur room but PLEASE keep common spaces clean and tidy)
- In ur 20s (no undergrads)
- Would want to be friends and hang out
- Is ok/like’s having people over in the apt
- Ideally 420 friendly

Non-negotiables:
- CLEAN roomies who take initiative taking care of the apt (this is the main reason I’m looking for a new place)
    - I am not a neat freak, I just need the bare minimum of cleaning up after yourself in the kitchen/bathroom in a timely manner
- Large room for my bunny
- No other pets to keep my bunny safe
- Laundry in unit
- Dishwasher
- No AI enthusiasts

About my bunny:
I currently keep Stevie in my room, but would love the opportunity to free roam him in the apt (he’s litter trained). Alternatively, I would need a large bedroom (min ~12x12ft) to keep him in. 
Stevie is a gemini and loves meeting new people. I always say he has the friendliness of a puppy, the attitude of a cat, and the shape of a rabbit! 

I have a good credit score, rent history, a guarantor, and can provide references from previous roomies lol

Please message me if you’re interested!

Please DM me here or on instagram @/jaewki if you are interested, thank you so much!!

text:
Hi everyone! I’m Trevor and I’ll be moving to NYC for a new job from Dallas in late March (ideally move in before March 24th, by April 1st at the latest). I will be in NYC to tour apartments from March 6th to 15th. 

Preferably looking for a roommate around my age to find an apartment with in southwest Manhattan - preferred neighborhoods are FiDi, Battery Park City, Tribeca, SoHo, West Village, or Chelsea, but relatively open as long as my commute is reasonable. Budget is ~$2500/mo but could go up to $2750 if needed. 

I’d also be open to a long-term studio/1br or a short-term sublet through May 31, although my preference is to find a roommate for a 12-month lease. 

A little about me - I’m 25 years old, grew up in Dallas, and have been living there for the last 3 years since graduating from Princeton in 2023. I’m a pretty social guy, and in my free time I like to work out, try new food, see live music (big fan of the arts in general), hang out with friends, watch sports (basketball/football/rugby), read, play video games, hike, and travel. As a roommate, I’m respectful and clean. I’ll be working in investment banking so I’ll be pretty busy with work and will be in person 5-6 days/week. Always down to find a new rooftop bar or Irish pub when I have some free time, though! 

I’m super excited to move to NYC and make it my new home! Feel free to reach out here or on instagram: @trevorholmes81

text:
Looking for room to rent// May 11th Move in (Flexible)- Aug 1st
Hi! I am a DC law student who will be working in NY for the summer, looking for a place to sublease -open to roommates! 

Preferably in Manhattan or Brooklyn my office is located in grand central station. 

budget - 3k max pref lower

Looking for a new roommate (May 1st move-in) for the second bedroom in our apartment and seeking a dog-friendly person, as we have a rescue pup (17-month-old) named Benny. (This does not mean you have to take care of a dog. He goes to daycare Mon-Fri till about 8 pm and is with me in my room when I'm home. If I'm ever out, he is left in my room, where he naps without whining.)

About the building: This is a secure building located in Bushwick, a block or two away from the Williamsburg border. There is an elevator, parking, a courtyard, and a gym. It's been here since 2008 & there are longtime owners and tenants, so it's well kept.
About the room: You will have your own bathroom, which I have just had a brand-new toilet installed. (You also have the larger bathroom.) About the apartment: It is a 2-bedroom, 2-bath apartment with a shared living room and dining room. I have a washer and dryer, a dishwasher, and a small terrace with a pretty cool view of Manhattan. I'm on the top floor (7th).

About the furniture: It includes a full-size bed, a desk, a TV, and a few small dressers. (We can talk about moving in your furniture, if you like.) There is a closet with a pretty high ceiling.

Regarding the lease, I am flexible. My last boarders (from The Listings Project and the other from Facebook) had three-month leases. One was a doctoral student, and the current one is a law student!

ONE MONTH DEPOSIT REQUIRED. A credit check (which I conduct), proof of income, and a reference would be greatly appreciated.
About us: Working professionals (I actually work in higher ed, which is why I like to rent to students, but am open to working professionals, too! I work one day a week at home, the rest in the office! My boyfriend works in human services and fitness and is out of the house every single day.) We are usually pretty quiet at home. Not the type to bring the party home. We like to cook a few weeknights each week.

I am the owner/landlord.
Rent is $2150 per month with utilities included.

text:
Bedroom with en suite bath - East Village -
June 1 move in
The second floor of our three floor 3bed 3bath is coming available June 1 and we are looking for someone to fill it for a 12 month lease renewal.

Rent: 3200/month. Other rooms are 3100 and 2600 but are not available.

Room: Lots of windows, a ton of space for a desk, dresser, couch, bed, and whatever else you might want to put in there. The bathroom is en suite which is really nice. And the bedroom itself has great views of midtown and Brooklyn. The room is on its own floor of the unit so there is a ton of privacy.

Apartment: The apartment has a ton of outdoor space with a terrace off the front and a private roof on top with 360 views of the whole city, we are often hosting because of this but try not to have anything big run too late. There is a dishwasher in the unit as well as storage under the stairs and good amount of storage in the cabinets in the kitchen as well.

Building: The building is a full doorman building which is super helpful for packages and has laundry + a gym in the basement. Building has an elevator and the apartment is floors 8, 9, and 10 though there are no other units up there with us. The building is at 7th and B, just off the corner of Tompkins Square Park.

Roommates: 25M and 29M, working in sales strategy and management consulting respectively. Generally more social in the warmer months when we are hosting more but overall friendly, happy to expand our plans and pretty clean.

Nothing beats the energy of a final walkthrough! 

Seeing the smiles, the excitement, and the "we’re finally home" realization is exactly why I do what I do.

Huge congratulations to my clients on their beautiful new space! It’s been an honor helping you navigate this journey, and I couldn't be happier to see you get the keys. 

Thinking of buying or selling? Let’s get you to the finish line!

Maruf Miah, Realtor®

text:
**Looking for Summer Sublease (6/11–9/8) – Studio/1BR or Room**

Hi! I’m looking for a summer sublease in NYC from around June 11 – September 8 (dates somewhat flexible).

Ideally, I’m looking for a studio or 1-bedroom, but I’d definitely be open to a private room in a shared apartment as well. My budget is around $2200.

Preferred areas (flexible!): Lower East Side, East Village, Alphabet City, Kips Bay, around NYU, or anywhere along the L train in Brooklyn.

A bit about me: I’m 26 and a PhD student at UCSB, coming to NYC for a summer internship. I’m clean, respectful, and easygoing, very low-drama, and generally a great tenant :))

If you have something available or know of a place, feel free to message me. Thanks!

Studio apartment available for a 12mo lease on 22nd and 7th with a May 9th move in. You will be renting from property management, so standard qualifications apply (eg, salary >= 40x monthly rent, etc). Elevator and laundry in building. $3,147 rent. Significant interest - likely to have someone sign this or next week
Prior listing for pictures:

1 Bedroom-1 Bathroom Entire Luxury Apartment for Sublet in Downtown Brooklyn . FULLY FURNISHED

Right above The BROOKLYN CITYPOINT MALL; which features Trader Joe’s, Target, Alamo Drafthouse Movie Theater, Dekalb Market with lots of restaurants and Primark.

TRAIN STATIONS within 3 min walk: B,Q,R at Dekalb Ave Station 2,3 at Hoyt Street A,C,F,R at Jay Street Metrotech A,C,G at Hoyt Schermerhorn 2,3,4,5 at Nevins Street

BUILDING Features: 24 hour doorman, fully equipped GYM, laundry, cinema room, live in super, bikeroom(available for rent), Rooftop, Garden with Sun-bed Chairs and tables, 2 lounges.

RENT: $4800

UTILITIES: All included except electricity and internet.

AVAILABILITY: Starting from the beggining of March. Looking for Long term tenants.

REQUIREMENTS: Organized and clean people, couples welcomed, no pets, no parties, no smoking. 1 month deposit. Background Check and Proof of income required.

APARTMENT features: everything you see in the photos so I won’t name all of them:) Fully windowed walls, 17th floor so lots of light(!)

Kitchen comes fully equipped (pans-cutlery-cups-glasses-plates- even a nespresso machine), also features a marble counter, stainless steel appliances including a dishwasher.

Bedroom has 2 extra large closets and 6 chest of drawers, queen size bed, make-up table, desk and more.. Everything is included from towels to sheets, so you just need to bring your suitcase!

WALKING DISTANCE : CityPoint Mall (right below), Smith street with lots of restaurants and bars, Court st with shops and restaurants, DUMBO, Brooklyn Heights, Brooklyn Bridge, Fort Greene Park, BAM, NY transit Museum… and more!

PLEASE read carefully and private message me if you are interested!

Thank you so much!

text:
I am looking for someone to rent out the master bedroom in my 2 bedroom apartment w/ office on the Ridgewood/Bushwick border starting April 1. Rent is $1600/month.

Your room is unfurnished, bright and quiet and has its own private bathroom! There is a third bedroom that I use as an office during business hours M-F that you would have access to as well. There is enough room for a second desk or you could use it as a gym/yoga/storage area. 

The apartment itself has a large living/dining area and an updated open kitchen with an island and plenty of storage space. Central A/C and heat throughout (climate control!). You would have your own closet in the living room in addition to
the closet in your room. There is a deck area outside your room that we both have access to through our windows. 

The apartment is located right on Myrtle Avenue on the Ridgewood/Bushwick border a 3 minute walk to the Myrtle Wyckoff Subway Station (L and M trains), We are surrounded by grocery stores, laundromats, pharmacies, bars, restaurants, yoga studios, street food carts, bus lines and shopping. There is an Amazon Locker and a UPS access point around the corner for packages.  Walking distance to Maria Hernandez Park, The Bushwick Collective, and Bushwick and Ridgewood night-life and restaurant scene. 22 minutes via subway to Union Square. 

I work remotely 5 days a week from the home office.  I am clean but not necessarily a neat freak. I ask that you keep common areas clean and contribute to basic household chores. When I’m not working I’m usually out doing something active, out with friends, or at a Knicks/Islanders/Yankees game or relaxing at home binge watching something or reading. No smoking, vaping, drugs, partying or excessive drinking in the apartment. Occasional overnight guests are fine. No cats. Dogs ok as long as they don’t shed too much.

$1770 / month in Midtown
Available May 1st

$1,770 / month (Flex), $1990 / month (Full)

3 Bed 1.5 bathrooms apartment in Midtown

Hey all!

We have a flex room ($1,770 / month + Con Ed utilities) and a full room ($1,990 / month + Con Ed utilities) available in a 3-bed 1.5 bath apartment in a high-rise near Sutton Place. The lease begins on May 1, with the duration running through April 30, 2027.

Some amenities:
* In building laundry.
* 24 hour doorman + front desk.
* Central AC / heating in each room.
* Dishwasher / Built-in Microwave.
* Great lighting!

~7 min walk to the E/M/6 at Lexington and 53rd, and the M15, M31, M50, and M57 bus lines are all within a 5min walk).

Nearby there are plenty of coffee shops, restaurants, grocery stores (D’Agostino, Morton Williams, tons of bodegas, etc.), and the neighborhood is pretty quiet.

You’d be moving in with two male roommates in their mid- 20s:

Siddharth -- me! (25): I've lived in the city for 4 years (2 in this apartment). I work in banking and in my free time, I like to go golfing, hiking, and bar hopping. Love trying new foods and meeting new people.

Roomate 2: TBD (could be my college friend!)

Place is quiet if you wfh.

Need to make 40x rent and have good credit (700+ credit score required).

*You’ll need to complete an application and get approval from the building and then pay a security deposit to the outgoing roommate.

If you’re interested and think you’d be a good fit, DM a little about yourself. Also reach out with any Qs!

Looking for a clean, chill male roommate to take over my room in a spacious 4B2B apartment in the Upper West Side/Manhattan Valley area!

**🔄 Bonus:** Option to officially join/renew the lease starting August 1st!

**📍 The Location:**
* **Columbia University:** 11-minute walk : perfect for students/researchers! 🎓
* **Transit:** 5-minute walk to the 103rd St Subway (get Downtown in 20 mins! 🚇)

**🏠 The Space:**
* **Your Room:** Bright, spacious, and **fully furnished** (Queen bed, mattress, study desk, chair, drawers, and A/C). Just bring your suitcase! 🧳
* **Apartment Perks:** In-unit **Washer/Dryer** (rare for NYC! 🧺), Dishwasher, Microwave, and a cozy furnished living room with a TV and sofa. 🛋️

**🤝 The Roommates:** You’ll be living with 3 super chill flatmates. It’s a great environment, quiet enough for deep work but close to all the NYC action. 🗽

**🏷 Rent:** $1,500/month + utilities.

**📲 Interested?** DM me for more details! This is a perfect home base for a summer intern or incoming student.

Gorgeous Fidi Bedroom + Private Bath Sublet!

I’m looking for someone to take over my lease from May 1st (flexible to start earlier) through Oct 1st (can do shorter sublets as well) with the option to continue after! 

This apartment has 3 total bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, and I’m subletting a large bedroom with a gorgeous view of the Brooklyn Bridge and Seaport. It currently has a full bed (easily fits queen/king as seen in photos), desk, several shelves and night stands with lots of room to spare and plenty of natural light.

You’d have a private bathroom that is not attached, shared/furnished living room and shared/stocked kitchen. The building has an elevator, doorman, mailroom, laundry room, gym, lounge, and rooftop.

Your roommates would be two 25 year old ladies who both work hybrid jobs and are very clean and friendly!

DM if you’re interested!

Hi! Looking for a female roommate in my 2 bedroom apartment in BedStuy starting 4/1! 

$1235 + utilities + Wi-Fi ($25)

I’ve lived here for almost 4 years and have a good relationship with the building. The current lease runs till July 1st so this is a 3-month sublet (4/1-6/30) with the potential to renew the lease with me. Priority would be given to people who is interested in staying long term. **2BD Sublease from May 1**

Hi everyone! My roommate and I are looking for someone to takeover our 2b/1ba (1 bd flex) apartment in Midtown East. Flex wall can be taken down if interested in 1Bd.

Lease: Available from 5/1/2026 until the end of the lease on 7/31/2026.

Rent: $4795 ($2397.5/room) plus flat rate for utilities & WiFi

Amenities: Doorman; Laundry in Building; Gym and Lounge Room access.

Details:

• Both rooms are very well sized. The bedroom has a closet inside the room, while the Flex room has a closet outside. The Flex room has a wall that goes up to the ceiling with a door.

• Tons of closet space

• Walking distance from the E/F at Lex/53rd and the 4/5/6/7 at Grand Central

• Trader Joe’s, Whole Foods, and local grocery stores within walking distance

DM if interested/to set up a tour.

text:
LEASE TAKEOVER - April 1st
Private room in a 3BD/1BTH apartment in Bed-Stuy - join our lease! Move in available 3/30.  $1,334/mo plus utilities. 

Up-to-date bathroom, dishwasher, hardwood floors, tall ceilings, closet, and North facing room gets a ton of natural light. Kitchen has a built-in speaker for music. Utilities are around $150/mo/person.

Building amenities include:
-  finished rooftop
-  laundry in basement
-  gym
-  theater/pool table/game room
-  elevator
-  secure mail room
-  secure bike storage area

J, M, and G lines are a 10-15 min walk B38 and other buses are about 1-2 min walk Grocery store across the street
Herbert Von King Park 7 min walk

LGBTQ+ friendly, 420 friendly (outside of common spaces), and both roommates are kind and clean. No cats please! First month + security deposit, application with management. 40x rent annually and good credit.

About Daisy (25, she/her) - hello! I work as a public defense paralegal in Queens. I'm originally from upstate NY, went to UChicago, and will be off to law school later this year. I’m usually either weightlifting at the gym, reading for one of my book clubs, chatting about the news, or finding random events and lectures to go to around the city. I'm a respectful communicator and tend to be quite clean. Excited to meet you 🙂

Gabbi (29, she/they)
Hey everyone! I sell insurance by day and multidisciplinary creative at night. I enjoy writing music, painting, modeling, and designing jewelry. I’m originally from Phoenix, AZ and moved here to further my skills in the arts. I’m queer, 420 friendly, and sadly allergic to cats. I’m pretty clean and value open communication. My IG is http://www.Instagram.com/gabbipaulo looking forward to meeting ✨

Neighborhood - 

- Very close to parks and green spaces.

- Trader Joe’s and Target within a 3 min walk, and Whole Foods within an 8 min walk. 

- City Point Mall is a 3 min walk away. 

- The building is 2 min from Hoyt Schermerhorn station (A/C/G trains), 4 min walk to Hoyt Street station (2/3 trains), 4 min walk to Dekalb (R/Q/B trains), 6 min walk to Nevins street / Borough Hall (4/5 trains) and 8 min walk to Jay St Metro-tech (F train). 8 min walk to Atlantic Terminal for LIRR. **Available APRIL 1-JUNE 1 ** 2K PER MONTH** UTILITIES INCLUDED

Spacious East Village Studio | 333 E 17th St | 800+ Sq Ft

Located on the first floor of a classic East Village building, this expansive 800+ square foot studio at 333 E 17th Street is a rare downtown find. It offers a scale you almost never see in a studio, while still feeling grounded, calm, and intentionally minimal.

The apartment is clean, quiet, and remarkably versatile. The layout allows for distinct living and sleeping areas without interrupting the flow. A Japanese futon serves as the primary bed, and a Thai mattress is also available, offering flexibility for guests or alternate setups. The openness of the floor plan makes it ideal for someone who values space, simplicity, and room to breathe in the middle of Manhattan.

Hardwood floors run throughout, complemented by high ceilings and exposed brick that bring warmth and texture to the space. The fireplace mantle adds character, and the generous open floor area gives the studio a loft-like feel. It is understated and adaptable, whether left minimal or thoughtfully styled.

The kitchen is set apart from the main living area and includes full-sized appliances. The bathroom is clean and functional with classic tile and good separation from the rest of the apartment.
The location is truly exceptional. You are in the heart of the East Village, steps from Union Square, Stuyvesant Town, and Tompkins Square Park, surrounded by some of the best restaurants, cafés, bars, and markets in the city. The L train at 1st Avenue and the 4, 5, 6, N, Q, R, W at Union Square are all within close reach, making downtown, Midtown, and Brooklyn easily accessible.

Despite being at the center of it all, the apartment itself feels like a quiet landing place. It works beautifully as a short term creative retreat, whether you are in the city for work, writing, studying, rehearsing, or simply wanting to experience downtown New York with real space to live in.

For someone looking for real square footage, strong bones, and an unbeatable downtown address at a great value, this is a rare opportunity.

text:
AVAILABLE APRIL 12-JUNE 1ST $2400 ($1500/MONTH) UTILITIES INCLUDED

204 MacDonough is a beautiful apartment escape from the hustle and bustle of NYC. It is on a painstakingly beautiful and quiet street that is lined with pre-war brownstones. The apartment is located in a very kind and loving community, where nearly every building and street is lined with flowing trees, gardens and plants. After living in NYC for 26 years, in many different neighborhoods, I can confidently say that this is my favorite place that I have had the opportunity to live.

This is a recently renovated, sunny two bedroom apartment with a private fire escape to a backyard jungle of trees, countless birds as well as access to a roof. The windowed kitchen has custom cabinets, stone countertops and modern appliances. The bathroom boasts modern fixtures, porcelain tiles, a tub, as well as a window for proper ventilation. There are hardwood floors, high ceilings and excellent closet space throughout the unit. Heat and hot water are included in the rent. The Apt is on the top floor, so no noisy neighbors will be above you. As mentioned, there is a private fire escape with access to a roof with panoramic views of Manhattan. 

There are several laundromats within a two block radius of the apartment. The C train is a 2 block/3 minutes walk as well and gets you to downtown Manhattan in 20 minutes. You are steps away from countless amazing restaurants and bars as well as grocery stores, dollar stores and anything one might need can easily be found steps away on Fulton street. 

The building is fairly quiet with respectful and friendly neighbors. There is a space out front to lock one’s bike up (I have a moped) and we have near private/exclusive access to the roof. Living on the top floor provides an added benefit of not having any loud neighbors/heavy feet above you. With beautiful daily sunsets and amazing natural light, it is easy to get lost and find peace in a place like this.

$1,770 / month

3 Bed 1.5 bathrooms apartment in Midtown

Hey all!

We have a flex room ($1,770 / month + Con Ed utilities) available in a 3-bed 1.5 bath apartment in a high-rise near Sutton Place. The lease begins on May 1, with the duration running through April 30, 2027.

Some amenities:
* In building laundry.
* 24 hour doorman + front desk.
* Central AC / heating in each room.
* Dishwasher / Built-in Microwave.
* Great lighting!

~7 min walk to the E/M/6 at Lexington and 53rd, and the M15, M31, M50, and M57 bus lines are all within a 5min walk).

Nearby there are plenty of coffee shops, restaurants, grocery stores (D’Agostino, Morton Williams, tons of bodegas, etc.), and the neighborhood is pretty quiet.

You’d be moving in with two male roommates in their mid- 20s:

Siddharth -- me! (25): I've lived in the city for 4 years (2 in this apartment). I work in banking and in my free time, I like to go golfing, hiking, and bar hopping. Love trying new foods and meeting new people.

Roomate 2: My college friend!

Place is quiet if you wfh.

Need to make 40x rent and have good credit (700+ credit score required).

*You’ll need to complete an application and get approval from the building and then pay a security deposit to the outgoing roommate.

If you’re interested and think you’d be a good fit, DM a little about yourself. Also reach out with any Qs!

Subletting my room in a lovely 3-bed 2-bath, Williamsburg apartment (South 4th & Driggs).

We moved in this past July and the whole building was gut-renovated, so all appliances are new. 

My room comes with a queen bed, desk, smaller TV, walk-in closet, and really solid natural light. I work remote here every day and it’s a great WFH setup.

Roommates are two guys in their mid-20s from London and Tokyo - both chill, clean, and easy to live with.

$2,500 for 5 weeks, willing to listen to pro-rated offers for 3 or 4 weeks.
DM for more info!

Rent is $2900 and it would be a March 15th move-in date. 

Bright and spacious 1-bedroom apartment located on a beautiful block one of the most charming areas in the heart of the Upper East Side — just 15–20 minutes walking to Midtown and surrounded by everything you need.

The apartment features:

- Comfortable living room (rare for NYC!)
- Spacious bedroom with ton of natural light
- Functional kitchen with good storage
- Well-proportioned layout overall
- Location is unbeatable:
      2 blocks from Trader Joe’s
      5 blocks from Central Park
      Steps from major subway lines (4, 5, 6, N, Q, R, F, M)
      Tons of restaurants, coffee shops, and neighborhood charm

Perfect balance between a quiet, residential vibe and being 10 minutes from everything.

URGENT LEASE TAKEOVER - Spacious furnished studio with panoramic city views
Hi everyone, I’m posting on behalf of my sister in law, who is looking for someone to sublease her apartment:

📍 345 E 94th St

🗓 Move-in ready ASAP

Lease ends August 12, 2026, but she’s flexible and open to a shorter sublease if needed.

This is a luxury building with a 24/7 doorman/security and on-site parking (includes its own parking spot). The building offers tons of great amenities, including:

 • Fitness center (with Peloton bikes)

 • Terrace with grills

 • Resident lounge with fireplace

 • Screening area and shared kitchen

 • On-site parking

The apartment is move-in ready and perfect for anyone looking for a comfortable, full-service building on the Upper East Side.

Please message me if you’re interested or would like more details/photos!

Move Out: March 24, 2027 (option to renew)
No broker fee
Fully furnished! 
IKEA furniture is included throughout along with TV (bed not included). No amenity fees. 

✨ The Highlights:
• Spectacular skyline + Manhattan and Roosevelt Island views
• In-unit washer/dryer
• Modern finishes, flooded with natural light
• Doorman + elevator building

text:
Hi! I’m opening up my Greenpoint apartment over the next couple of months and looking for the right fit (super clean, considerate) ✨

April: 1 bedroom available ($1.8–2K)

May: full apartment available (2 bed + office) while I’m traveling

The space gets amazing light, feels calm and cozy, and is in a great part of Greenpoint. Building has a gym, rooftop views, courtyard, and more.

Open to short-term or slightly longer depending on the situation — flexible for the right person/people.

Would be perfect for someone in between places or looking for a soft landing in Brooklyn.

No Pets.

If you or someone you know might be interested, feel free to DM me

text:
Private Bath Opportunity — 4 Bed / 4 Bath Apartment
📍 62-15 Catalpa Ave 1L, Ridgewood, Queens
🚫 No broker fee

Spacious 4-bedroom apartment where every room has access to a full bathroom, plus a large basement suite with backyard access. Perfect for roommates who want privacy without sacrificing space.

Room Pricing:
Room 1 – $1,365 → Double windows, street-facing, full bath outside
Room 2 – $1,430 → Largest room, full bath inside
Room 3 – $1,325 → Back-facing, full bath outside
Room 4 – $1,530 → Full basement suite, private bath inside + backyard access

Apartment Features:
• All rooms have closets + full bathrooms
• Backyard access (Room 4)
• Spacious layout with strong separation between rooms
• Ideal roommate setup with real privacy

Neighborhood — Ridgewood, Queens:
Ridgewood sits right on the Brooklyn/Queens border, giving you a low-key neighborhood feel with easy city access.

• M train access (Fresh Pond Rd / Forest Ave)
• Quick commute to Bushwick, Williamsburg, and Manhattan
• Mix of cafes, bakeries, and local spots
• Residential vibe with quieter, cleaner blocks
• Grocery stores, gyms, and essentials nearby

If you’re looking for a true roommate-friendly layout with real privacy, this is one of the better setups you’ll find.

Hey, I’m Eddiley — I’m a licensed realtor and I help match roommates for places like this.  

I’ll be coordinating the roommates for the apartment and guiding everyone through the process.  

Shoot me a quick message about yourself, your move-in date, and when you’re free to check it out, and we’ll go from there.

4/17 MOVE IN- IN SEARCH OF 2 ROOMMATES ASAP�(previously was April 1st move in but is now extended)

Hi! My roommate, Sanya, and I are looking for 2 girls to join us in a 4bed/2bath apartment in Murray Hill!

The apartment is walking distance from the 6 train, Grand Central Station, M34 bus, Trader Joe’s, etc.

The building has 24/7 doorman, elevator, and laundry room.

AVAILABLE ROOMS:

Bedroom 1:

- $2300/month

- Fully private room, fits queen size bed, large closet

Bedroom 2:

- $1450/month

- Fully private room, fits twin size bed, small closet

- No windows 

A little about us: 

We’re both 23 and graduated in May and have been living in the city since August. We are clean, friendly, and respectful roommates looking for others who are the same! Outside of work, we both enjoy going out with friends, traveling, and trying new things around the city (workout classes, dancing, happy hours, restaurants, pop ups, etc)!

Feel free to message me on fb or dm us on instagram (@krishi.kothari or @sanyasshetty) if you’re interested / want more details, would love to chat :))��

**SUMMER IN BATTERY PARK CITY - FURNISHED ROOM AVAIL APRIL -SEPTEMBER **

Luxury Waterfront High Rise |  POOL + Hudson River Views 

$2750 including utilities & WiFi

Waterfront Esplanade for walking and jogging, biking and volleyball. Close to Whole Foods, Brookfield Place and the World Trade Center Oculus. Short walk to Subway Lines: 1, R/W, E/A, 4/5 trains. 5 minute walk to Ferry. Easy commute to FiDi, Tribeca, Soho, Greenwich Village

Convenient bus access. Free outdoor concerts

This is a furnished room that’s filled with a lot of natural light. It has a full-size bed, a dresser, and a small workspace with access to a private closet for storage. Shared spaces – living room, kitchen, and bathroom. The apartment is on a high floor so it's pretty  quiet- perfect for work or study. I am a NYC native and I live here with my little dog - dog lovers are welcome! * 

Preference is for a female but open to all inquiries

No couples, No pets, Non Smoker 

AMENITIES:
* 24/7 Doorman, security, and controlled access  
* Private outdoor pool
* 8,000 square foot fitness center - NO FEE
* On-site office area for studying or work
* Resident Lounge
* Rooftop Terrace in adjacent building
* Laundry in building

Long term rental welcome.  

Please feel free to reach out for more details. [robbinsjanine3@gmail.com](mailto:robbinsjanine3@gmail.com)

text:
Hey guys,

I’m a 23 year old I work and I’m in school and in the shelter. I have been there about 4 months looking for a 1 bedroom or studio apartment with my CityFHEAPS voucher and I’m beginning to loose hope. If you know any brokers, real estate agents, landlords or buildings that accommodate my voucher I would be so grateful. My email is Manny.b7979@gmail.com and my number is 347-371-3964 my preference would be manhattan, Brooklyn and the Bronx but I’m also open to queens as long as it’s not as far as Jamaica since I go to school downtown I have to take into consideration public transportation.

Hi there! I’m looking for a roommate to resign the lease with me for end of May/beginning of June in a beautiful 2 bed/2 bath in Bushwick! 

Easy subway access + great location

About the apartment🏡:
-2 bed/2 bath (We each have our own private room and bathroom with a bathtub + great water pressure)
-In-unit laundry 🧺
-In the room available, giant closet
-AC/heating in all rooms
-Beautiful, spacious backyard shared between 6 units in the apt. 🌳
-Other residents in the apartment complex are super sweet (we even have an apartment group chat)
-Shared apartment basement (with a lock on it) for extra storage.
-Responsive management
-Pin pad lock outside building (packages are safe)
-The current rent is 1700 before utilities (it might go up to 1800, in talks with management)

🚊 -3 min walk to the J/M trains Flushing stop (~less than 20 mins to get into Manhattan; we’re located on the border of Bushwick, Williamsburg, and Bed-Stuy so nice connectivity within Brooklyn).

🛒-Multiple grocery stories around the corner including Horseradish and Food Bazaar (and so many more within walking distance).

About me💟:
I’m 24, moved to New York last summer to start grad school at NYU studying Psychology. From California, and spent the last couple of years since undergrad traveling/volunteering abroad.

I love art, music, and food so I’m always out exploring different events, galleries, and cafes. I’m a cozy night in or a fun night out type of person.

I prioritize a clean, organized living space. I’m super communicative and would love to be friends with my roommate. I like to host (intentional gatherings) from time to time, and would love to do that together!

About you✨:
Looking for someone in my age range (20’s) who’s also a professional/in school.

Communicative, can respect quiet hours, and cleans up. Down to be social but not always bringing the party home.

Good vibes are the biggest priority in my living space. Kindness, mutual respect, communication, and friendship are ideal!

Application requirements:
Valid ID
Last year's tax return
4 pay stubs
2 bank statements
Proof of rent payments
W-2

Cheers!

text:
**Roommates (& New Friends) Wanted!!! Early-Mid May Move In, ~$1000 per month budget for Weird Fun Creative Good Vibes Woohoo Home! In Brooklyn or Uptown Manhattan **

Hi!!!!! I’m moving to NYC soon, and I’m hoping to move in with 3-4 cool new people so we can build something awesome together! My hope is to find roommates first, and then in late April we can find an apartment together

Apartment Basics:
* Budget: ~800-1200 per person depending on apartment
* Size: 4-5 Bedroom Apartment (so 4-5 roommates total)
* Location: Leaning towards Brooklyn (Bushwick/Bed-Stuy or Flatbush/Prospect Heights), or Uptown Manhattan (Washington Heights, Harlem, Inwood). This is flexible!!!
* Hoping for something spacious enough for hosting friends and such
* Hoping for in-unit laundry/dish washer
* Lease: 1 year lease, though hoping for something that will last longer than that 
* Move In Date: Early May! May 15th would be the latest and probably most likely, but if we can find a spot earlier then amazing! I’ll be landing back in the states starting on the 21st of April so May 1st would probably be the earliest.

Apartment Vibes!!!
* Community! Not a crazy party-every-night type of vibe, but I would LOVE to have a social home, host events here, bring people together, and make our place somewhere super welcoming.
* Creative! I’d love for the house to be a home base for everyone’s creative projects, whether for filming indie movies, recording music or podcasts, or something else too!
* Cleanliness: Looking for neither neat freaks nor slobs! Shouldn’t mind if someone has left a couple dishes in the sink, but also shouldn’t be leaving massive piles themself.

About You:
* Age range: 21-34
* Progressive, Queer & BIPOC friendly. “girls & gays” type of vibe lmao
* A fair balance of having passions and things you’re driven towards and working on while also being able to have fun together, going out dancing, and being silly goofy woohoo together
* Communicative, kind, respectful, empathetic, supportive and all!!!
* Must have reliable income or a guarantor
* I’m really trying to be intentional about this and hoping to create not just a place to live in, but a home (awww lol). If you’re only looking for a place to live and are fine being strangers with your roommates, then this probably isn’t for you!

Brief about me:
* My name is Star! I’ve spent the past 4 years traveling, I taught English in rural Thailand for 1.5 years and then lived in Australia (Melbourne) for 2 years. I’ll be starting off working in hospitality and/or teaching ESL, but I’m hoping to move into something to help stop the US from being on fire lmao.
* My goal this year is to bring more play into my life and rediscover my silly goofy radiantly cringe self!!! Woo!!!
* My facebook profile and ig are incredibly out of date so you wont get what you expect if you stalk me there. 

Send me a message with a little bit about yourself, what you want out of a home, and we can go from there!

Looking for a room to rent in ridgewood / bushwick. Open to options. Prior service, in college, don’t drink or do drugs, usually always out because I love outdoor hobbies. Don’t really matter if room mate is girl or guy. As long as they’re respectful. Lmk

Hi everyone! I’m looking for a room for rent or a sublet in the Brooklyn area starting June 1st! 
My budget is roughly 800-1000 monthly 
I’m a licensed cosmetologist from upstate looking to move into the city 
Preferably girls or queer households 
Any help is greatly appreciated!

ISO Roommate (3rd Roommate for a 3B2B Apartment!)

Hi everyone!

My roommate and I are currently looking for a third female roommate to join us in a 3 bed / 2 bath apartment.

We’re primarily looking at luxury apartments in Midtown and FiDi with good amenities, views, and in-building laundry.

The room:
• A flex bedroom
• Rent: approx. $2,100–$2,200/month (depending on layout)
• You would be sharing a bathroom with one other roommate

Details:
• Move-in: mid-April
• Lease: 12 months
• We’re currently actively house hunting and would love someone to join us in finalizing and signing a lease together

A little about me:
I work as a Landscape Architect and Urban Designer. I’m clean, respectful, and easygoing, and I value a calm and comfortable home environment. I’m vegetarian (would love a vegetarian/vegan roommate but open to others). Outside of work I enjoy reading, dancing, exploring bookstores and cafés, and spending time outdoors.

If you’re interested in joining us or want to house hunt together, feel free to message me!

Thanks so much!!

🏡 Spare Bedroom in Stunning Strivers’ Row Townhouse — West Harlem
$1,800 mo + utilities (~$80–125/season) | Private Bath | W/D In-Unit

This is my favorite apartment I’ve ever lived in, and I think you’ll feel it the moment you walk in.

I’m renting out the spare bedroom in my gorgeous Strivers’ Row apartment — one of the most iconic and storied addresses in all of New York City. The space is huge, the building is beautiful, and the neighborhood has a character you simply can’t find anywhere else in Manhattan.

About the apartment:

 ∙ Your own private bathroom — no sharing

 ∙ Washer & dryer in-unit

   HUGE closet space in your bedroom.

 ∙ Dishwasher and all new appliances

 ∙ Spacious layout with real breathing room

 ∙ Move-in date flexible, but hoping to find the right fit soon

About the neighborhood — and why Strivers’ Row is special:

Strivers’ Row (officially the St. Nicholas Historic District) is a landmarked block of late 19th-century rowhouses protected by the New York City Landmarks Preservation Commission and listed on the National Register of Historic Places. The brownstones here have been owned by the same families for generations — this is not a transient block. It’s a genuine community with deep roots and real neighbors who look out for each other. West Harlem has transformed significantly and continues to thrive, but Strivers’ Row in particular has always been a safe, quiet, residential enclave — tree-lined, grounded, and proud.

About me (your roommate)

I work in finance, love a calm home, and treat my apartment like a sanctuary. I love interior design and have loved making this space into a fun home for me and my dog. I have a miniature schnauzer who is hypoallergenic, elderly, quiet, and honestly just sleeps. She’s sweet and unobtrusive — you’ll barely know she’s there. I’m looking for someone clean, respectful, and who keeps the party elsewhere. Chill, professional energy preferred.

DM me if you’re interested — happy to chat and show the space! 🤍

Imagine living just a 10-minute stroll from the pristine sands of Venice Beach! 🌴☀️This exceptionally solid, lovingly maintained home is the perfect coastal retreat you’ve been waiting for🎉

Why You’ll Love This Home:
* Prime Location: Walk to the beach, shopping, library, schools, and parks! 🚶‍♂️🏖️
* Built to Last: A fortress of a home that has stood strong through every storm with zero structural damage.
* Major 2025 Upgrades: Brand-new high impact double paned windows, new pool heater, new water heater, and more!
* Ultimate Privacy: Dual sliding glass doors allow you to close off the Lanai/TV room perfect for kids or a quiet home office.
* Tropical Oasis: Massive rear deck and backyard featuring your very own fruiting mango tree! 🥭
* Pristine History: Meticulously cared for by only two owners and never smoked in.
Outdoor Fun & Potential
Take a dip in your heated pool or host a BBQ on the expansive deck. While the landscaping is ready for your creative touch after the recent seasons, the bones of this home are rock solid and ready for move-in!

Don’t miss this chance to own a piece of Venice paradise! Whether you’re looking for a forever home or a savvy coastal investment, this is a MUST  SEE!

📲 Call or Text me today at 941-303-0104 to schedule your private tour!
Yelena Golovatyuk☀️ALL FLORIDA SELL BUY INVEST/ KW Luxury St Pete/ Born to Serve - Your Florida Realtor for Life!

text: Hi! A friend and I are both law students who will be in the city this summer for summer internships! We are 24 & 25. We are looking for a furnished 2 bedroom or 1 bedroom flex to sublease for the summer. Our specific dates are flexible, but we are looking for something starting towards the end of May /beginning of June through July / early August. We prefer something downtown! Reach out with any questions or leads!

Hi!! I’ll be interning in SoHo this summer, hence looking for a room sublease from around June 6- August 14. Midtown/Downtown preferred. Open to female flatmates, but have a mild preference for an attached bathroom. Please comment/DM if you have leads!

Welcome!

1200$ month

This is a unit on a first floor, the space is next to a park, room is filled with natural light during the day.

The apt has the shape of a “U”. Therefore both rooms on each end.

The tenant prefers someone who doesn’t work or studies from home.

Space is 240sqft

In the room there is a: clothing rack, small clothed and a big, 3 rack plastic drawer and a small desk and chair. (optional items, free to use, if you need them).

Kitchen and bathroom is shared

Utilities included per month: Yes

Kitchen has available: microwave, air fryer, panini press, mini oven, stove & space in the fridge.

No smoking in unit.

Pets are welcome, each pet is 25$ extra per month

Flatmate agreement will have to be reviewed and signed prior move in.

Due to agreements and traffic, we can’t provide a mailbox key. your regular mail will be handed off to you. Amazon delivery etc just as regular.

Couples: 1600$ per month

About The flatmate:

My mom, with 1 cat in the unit.

She’s kept to her self, loves to cook and spends most of her time at home, or running errands.

Cats friendly and quiet.

NEIGHBORHOOD: Here we have the “1 and “A” trains. Also buses that can take you all around new york city. 30mins to time square. 20mins to city college.

A lot of dining, beauty shops and super market options.

During the mornings, people are heading to work or taking their kids to school, and vise versa during the evening.

near address for any loc research: 40 Wadsworth Terrace, New York, NY 10040

I like to have a phone call first prior physical visits.

About You:

Please have a linkin or IG, any visual socials ready to share with current pictures of you.

I ask folks to provide:

1 copy of a form of gov ID, 3 references, proof of work / income

Please have this site or any, with a background check already done.

All applicants must earn 28X the rent.

Please be ready to provide for the first and last month of rent before move in

thank you for your time! :)

Hey! I’m Steven! Looking for 1–2 roommates to apartment hunt with for a May 1 move, but I am flexible on timing. I work in sustainability consulting in Flatiron, so ideally looking for somewhere within a ~30 min commute. My budget is around $2K max (but always down for a good deal). I would love to be in Manhattan or Brooklyn and the top areas I’m considering are the East Village, Gramercy, LES, FiDi, Cobble Hill, and DUMBO, but I’m definitely open to other neighborhoods too. I’m 23 (turning 24 soon) and pretty social…I like working out, being outside, concerts, and going out with friends. Would love a friendly, social apartment where we get along and can have people over occasionally. Ideally looking for someone around my age and LGBTQ-friendly.

If this sounds like a fit, feel free to message me here or on Instagram @stevenburns11.

We are really big on communication and looking out for eachother however we can 😊 looking for a roommate with similar values 🤍✨ please message me if interested! 🫶

text:
Two pilots were killed and 41 people were taken to hospitals after an Air Canada flight struck a Port Authority fire rescue vehicle on a runway at LaGuardia Airport late Sunday, officials said.

Around 11:40 p.m. a Jazz Aviation flight operating on behalf of Air Canada hit an Aircraft Rescue and Firefighting vehicle that was responding to a separate incident, according to a Port Authority spokesperson.

The pilot and co-pilot died in the collision.

Thirty-nine people on the plane and two fire officers were taken to hospitals. Officials did not immediately provide details on their conditions.

LaGuardia will remain closed until at least 2 p.m. Monday to allow for a thorough investigation. The National Transportation Safety Board is on site, and Port Authority police are working with airline partners and federal authorities.

#canada #airplane #incident #usa
